description:
## Why

DANE (RFC 6698 + 7671 + 7672 + related) is an underdeployed trust mechanism. Strategic goal (Mark, 2026-05-12): encourage DANE adoption by making it the default behavior of the workspace's TLS verification path, with zero required consumer code change. Layered control via:

1. **Compile gate** — pkix-chain Cargo feature `dane`, default-on. Consumers who don't want DANE deps use `--no-default-features`.
2. **Runtime setting** — verify_tls_server accepts a DANE config (enable/disable, resolver override, failure-mode policy). Default config is 'on, built-in resolver, opportunistic fallback' subject to the decisions below.
3. **Call-site override** — explicit `verify_tls_server_no_dane` variant (or builder method) for callers who want pure PKIX in a DANE-default binary.

This commitment is filed now; implementation is future work.

## Architectural shape

Two new sibling crates:

- **`pkix-dane`** (no_std) — TLSA record types + DER/wire parsing; per-usage match logic (RFC 6698 §2.1); per-usage verify functions (`verify_pkix_ta`, `verify_pkix_ee`, `verify_dane_ta` returning a synthesized TrustAnchor, `verify_dane_ee`). No DNS. Caller supplies validated TLSA records.

- **`pkix-dane-resolver`** (std) — DNSSEC-validating resolver (built on hickory-dns or equivalent). Fetches TLSA records for (host, port, proto) tuples. Built-in caching (TLSA records have TTLs).

`pkix-chain` integration:

- New `dane` Cargo feature, default-on.
- When enabled, `verify_tls_server` (PKIX-fmtv.11) automatically queries TLSA, applies DANE rules, falls through to PKIX on absence/failure (subject to failure-mode decision below).
- Resolver is overridable via builder / config.
- Pure-PKIX behavior preserved when feature disabled OR when runtime config sets DANE off.

## Why this shape

- **Adoption without consumer code change**: `cargo add pkix-chain` pulls DANE; existing call sites of verify_tls_server gain DANE behavior on the next `cargo update`.
- **Opt-out remains cheap**: `--no-default-features` removes the dep entirely. Embedded / minimal-dep consumers unaffected.
- **Preserves PKIX core integrity**: pkix-path stays no_std and DANE-naive. Only pkix-chain's high-level wrappers gain DANE.
- **Consistent with workspace adapter pattern**: `pkix-dane` / `pkix-dane-resolver` mirrors `pkix-revocation` / `pkix-revocation-http`.

## Trade-offs accepted

- pkix-chain's default-feature dep tree grows substantially (hickory-dns + likely tokio). pkix-chain crosses from minimal-dep orchestrator into opinionated convenience layer. AGENTS.md crate inventory rewording required.
- Verification gains a hidden network call by default. Previously offline workflows (cert audit, batch validation, air-gapped) need to opt out.
- Async-vs-sync resolver bridging is awkward. Per-call decision below.

## Children

- .1 — Create `pkix-dane` crate (no_std DANE primitives)
- .2 — Create `pkix-dane-resolver` crate (std DNSSEC resolver)
- .3 — pkix-chain: add `dane` Cargo feature default-on + runtime config in verify_tls_server (depends on .1 + .2 + PKIX-fmtv.11)
- .4 — Decide DANE failure mode (opportunistic vs strict vs operator-configurable). DEFERRED per Mark 2026-05-12; needs answer before .3 lands.
- .5 — Decide DNS config source (resolv.conf / hardcoded / env var / pluggable). Needs answer before .2 lands.
- .6 — Decide whether verify_smtp_signer (PKIX-fmtv.13) also gets DANE-default-on. SMTP-DANE has stronger production deployment via RFC 7672; case may be stronger than HTTPS-DANE.

## Stub status

This epic is the architectural commitment. Implementation work (children .1-.3) is future work. Decision children (.4-.6) can resolve at any time.

## Cross-references

- PKIX-fmtv.11 — verify_tls_server lives here. Its implementation should not foreclose on DANE composition; the design discussion already noted this.
- AGENTS.md crate inventory — add pkix-dane / pkix-dane-resolver as planned siblings (skeleton-status, similar to pkix-ac / pkix-ct).
- AGENTS.md non-negotiable #6 — Resolver trait must admit caching wrappers and cache-friendly result types.
- Memory pkix-dane-architecture-2026-05-12 (to be saved alongside this epic).
title: DANE integration: pkix-dane + pkix-dane-resolver + default-on Cargo feature in pkix-chain
